operations.replacement: lsp definition with explicit project_path/file and zero-based UTF-16 line/character; SDK capability checked
operations.boundary: Native LSP with explicit zero-based line and UTF-16 character positions; upstream uses one-based input positions. Capabilities are checked per selected SDK; unsupported providers return an explicit error without invented results. Installed SDK 26 ArkTS does not advertise documentSymbol/workspaceSymbol/call hierarchy. SDK clangd supports the first four new operations; outgoingCalls is explicitly unsupported. Verified status records these exact supported and unsupported outcomes.
